repository.name: MC_legends
protection_summary: Remote read-only planning run; branch protection/rulesets were not read.

product.vision: Create a reusable, disposable prototype lab for rapid gameplay and asset experiments without turning the prototype stack into the future production game architecture.
target_users: MC Legends creators and family playtesters
coding agents implementing short prototype slices
user_problems: Gameplay ideas need to become playable quickly without rebuilding camera, asset handling, reset and debug plumbing for every experiment.
Prototype code must not contaminate the production web foundation or silently become a commitment to a final game engine.
Assets need to be replaceable and traceable while visual direction is still evolving.
outcomes: A new experiment can be added through a stable experiment contract and isolated folder.
Assets can be swapped through a registry without changing mechanic code.
A future runtime adapter can provide third-person local play once project governance permits an engine choice.
Prototype results remain evidence for design decisions, not automatic canon.
out_of_scope: final game art and public brand release
capabilities: plug in one validated runtime adapter later
user_journeys: idea -> experiment specification -> agent implementation -> localhost play -> tune -> reset -> compare -> keep/discard learning
placeholder asset -> registry entry -> replacement asset -> replay experiment without mechanic rewrite

business.statement: Maximize time-to-learning from gameplay experiments instead of optimizing for production completeness.

domain.statement: Prototype hypotheses and Confluence design status must remain distinguishable; a prototype must never auto-promote tentative ideas to canon.

data.statement: Experiment metadata, tunables and asset provenance must be versioned in repository files; no database is justified for the first foundation.

integration.statement: The prototype lab may read design references conceptually, but it must not depend at runtime on Confluence, Jira, the web app, PostgreSQL or VPS services.

security_privacy.statement: Prototype fixtures and asset metadata must contain no real child names, credentials or private submission data.

reliability.statement: Every experiment must have a deterministic reset path and a smoke-testable startup contract once a runtime adapter exists.

performance.statement: No numeric frame-rate or load target is canonically established for the prototype lab; do not justify architecture with invented performance SLOs.

modifiability.statement: A new experiment should remain local to its experiment folder plus explicit registry changes; shared mechanics are promoted only after repeated use demonstrates value.
Replacing an asset must not require edits to gameplay mechanic code.

operability.statement: The first foundation is local-only and must not require backend, cloud, database or production deployment operations.

cost.statement: Avoid infrastructure, services and abstraction layers that do not directly reduce repeated prototype setup cost.

team_governance.statement: Coding agents require short repository rules, deterministic validation and explicit mutation boundaries.

delivery.statement: The prototype lab should be isolated from the production web repository so experimental churn does not enlarge its CI and release blast radius.

platform.statement: No standalone game engine or Minecraft loader may be selected while MCL-1 remains open under current project governance.
Third-person local gameplay is the current user preference for the first playable experiment, but the architecture concept must not hard-code camera perspective into shared contracts.

integrations: future runtime adapter only; none selected in this concept

quality_scenarios.response: the experiment is added without editing existing experiment implementations
quality_scenarios.response_measure: binary pass: changes are limited to experiments/<id> plus explicit registry/contract files and validation passes

quality_scenarios.stimulus: replaces a placeholder creature or environment asset
quality_scenarios.response: the experiment resolves the replacement through the same stable asset id
quality_scenarios.response_measure: binary pass: no gameplay mechanic source file changes are required for the replacement

quality_scenarios.stimulus: changes a gameplay parameter such as hearing radius, movement speed or alert delay
quality_scenarios.response: the parameter can be changed without editing runtime-adapter internals
quality_scenarios.response_measure: binary pass: the change is expressible in experiment tunables/config only

quality_scenarios.stimulus: implements a tentative or ambiguous design idea
quality_scenarios.response: the experiment records design status and source references and does not claim canon
quality_scenarios.response_measure: binary pass: design_status and source_refs are mandatory and schema-valid

quality_scenarios.response: the existing production web source, package manifest, tsconfig and CI remain unchanged
quality_scenarios.response_measure: binary pass: zero changed files in DYAI2025/MC_legends for the separate-repository option

quality_scenarios.response: the agent can identify allowed scope, protected boundaries, experiment template and gates without reading the production web implementation
quality_scenarios.response_measure: binary pass: AGENTS.md points to one ADR, one experiment contract, one asset contract and exact validation commands

existing_commitments: DYAI2025/MC_legends is the active web repository.
Confluence MLOA is the game-design SSoT for confirmed decisions.
Jira MCL-1 remains the product-format gate.
Current web architecture is Next.js ports/adapters and is explicitly web-only.

assumptions.statement: A separate prototype-lab repository is acceptable if it remains project-linked by source references rather than runtime coupling.
assumptions.review_trigger: User or governance requires a monorepo instead.

assumptions.statement: Third-person is the first prototype camera preference, not a canon game-format decision.
assumptions.review_trigger: The user changes the prototype camera preference.

conflicts.statement: The user wants an executable prototype basis now, while current AGENTS.md and open MCL-1 prohibit selecting a standalone game engine.
conflicts.review_trigger: MCL-1 is resolved or project governance explicitly permits a disposable non-canonical prototype runtime.

missing_information.statement: No approved runtime/engine adapter exists for the prototype lab.
missing_information.review_trigger: Engine governance gate is cleared and an adapter is researched/validated.

missing_information.statement: Branch protection/rulesets for a future prototype repository do not exist because the repository has not been created.
Final asset license policy for prototype-only third-party assets is not yet recorded.
missing_information.review_trigger: First external asset pack is selected.
